name: Mixer and DJ table
placement: Beside the dance floor or at the back of the audience for sound control, with a power strip close.
modeling: A black box tabletop (1.83 x 0.04 x 0.61) on four thin metal leg boxes to 0.95 m, a long black skirt panel on the front, and on top a flat mixer box, two small round platter cylinders and a laptop box with a tilted lid.
